name: Taihan Cable & Solution Co., Ltd.
summary: Taihan Cable & Solution Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells electric wires, cables, and related products worldwide. The company offers power generation products, such as transmission cables, distribution cables, industrial cables, heating systems, and busducts; renewable energy cables, comprising submarine and solar power cables; communication cables, including LAN, coaxial, railway, local communication, UL style, CATV, and other cables; and optical cables, which consists of outdoor and indoor optical cables, OPGW/photoelectric composite, conductors, and accessories, as well as base metal products that include copper rod and wires and magnet wires.
